## Changes

Describe the change and its gameplay/user impact.

Target `dev`. For a new game, link the proposal and explain controls, scoring,
rules version, replay limits, and reserve placement.

## Verification

- Typecheck, lint, build:
- Relevant game/integration tests:
- Clean-checkout setup and browser playthrough:
- Keyboard, themes, reduced motion:
- Screenshots or recording:

## Assets and data

List asset sources/licenses. Use synthetic data; include no credentials.

## Game review

For new games or substantial gameplay changes, complete the
[game review checklist](https://github.com/odom-technology/tixy/blob/dev/docs/game-review-checklist.md). Note inapplicable items
and any requested economy integrations (tickets, XP, quests, or payouts) for
maintainer review.
